The Haywood Combo Set combines the forgiveness of the CB2 with the precision and shot-making capabilities of the MB2, creating the ideal setup for golfers who want performance throughout every part of the bag.

By blending cavity-back long and mid irons with muscle-back scoring clubs, golfers gain added forgiveness where it matters most while maintaining the control, feel, and workability demanded for approach shots into the green. The result is a seamless transition throughout the set without compromising appearance, feel, or performance.

Both the CB2 and MB2 are forged from premium 1020 carbon steel and precision CNC milled to exacting tolerances, ensuring consistent feel and performance from club to club. Shared shaping characteristics, topline profiles, sole geometry, and premium chrome finishes create a unified appearance throughout the set.

Featuring the newly introduced V-Sole design, the Combo Set delivers improved turf interaction and cleaner contact across every iron. Whether attacking long par 5s, shaping approach shots into tucked pins, or controlling distance with scoring clubs, the Combo Set provides the ideal blend of forgiveness and precision.

Benefits & Features

• CB2 Forgiveness in Long and Mid Irons
• MB2 Precision in Short and Scoring Irons
• Forged from Premium 1020 Carbon Steel
• 100% CNC Milled Construction
• New V-Sole Design Throughout the Set
• Consistent Feel and Performance Across All Irons
• Premium Chrome Finish
• Improved Turf Interaction
• Enhanced Forgiveness Where Needed Most

• Seamless Visual Transition Throughout the Set

Golfers who want the forgiveness of a cavity back iron in the longer clubs and the precision of a muscle back iron in the scoring clubs.

The Haywood MB2 irons were designed for golfers who value precision above all else. Featuring a classic muscle-back profile, compact blade shape, and minimal offset, the MB2 delivers the feedback, control, and workability demanded by skilled ball strikers.

Forged from premium 1020 carbon steel and precision CNC milled, every MB2 iron is manufactured to exacting tolerances for unmatched consistency throughout the set. The refined muscle-back design positions mass directly behind the impact area, producing exceptional feel and shot control while allowing golfers to shape trajectories and work the ball with confidence.

The addition of a newly engineered V-Sole improves turf interaction through a variety of course conditions, helping the club move efficiently through the turf for cleaner contact and improved consistency. Combined with a thinner topline, compact blade length, and premium chrome finish, the MB2 delivers a timeless appearance preferred by accomplished players.

Built for golfers who appreciate precision craftsmanship and complete shot control, the MB2 offers a pure ball-striking experience with the soft forged feel that defines every Haywood iron.

Why You’ll Cheer Every Chip

products.title: 100's Heads Only
products.body_html:
Haywood 100’s – Precision Milled, Once‑in‑a‑Century Irons

The unicorn of players irons. Each Haywood 100 is carved—not cast, not forged and polished, but fully CNC‑milled—from a single billet of buttery‑soft 1020 carbon steel. One head spends more than 200 minutes under the bit, unveiling every micrometre of its design with surgical consistency. The result? A set so exacting that no two clubs differ by more than a human hair.

What Sets the 100’s Apart

  • 100 % CNC‑Milled Construction: Zero hand‑grinding, zero guesswork—just pure, computer‑perfect geometry every time.
  • Tour‑Refined Profile: Razor‑thin topline, minimal offset, and a compact blade length that frames the ball like a tour card in your back pocket.
  • Sharper Leading Edge + V‑Sole: Slides through tight lies and wet turf without digging, then powers through rough with an effortless nip.
  • Soft 1020 Carbon Steel Feel: That addictive “thump” on centre strikes and honest feedback everywhere else.
  • Hand‑Finished in Vancouver: Built to your exact loft, lie, length, and swing‑weight specs—then triple‑checked before it ever sees a box.

Availability

The remaining inventory is measured in single digits—and we mean single. Once they’re gone, the 100’s go back into the vault with no promise of a re‑run.

Why “100’s”?

Because they represent the 100 % commitment to precision milling, the 100 % focus on serious ball‑strikers, and the near‑zero chance you’ll find another set in your foursome.

Secure yours now—or spend the next decade searching eBay for a lightly‑used set that nobody’s willing to part with.

Need Them Built?

These are sold heads‑only, but we’re happy to build them into ready‑to‑play weapons. Just email us with your preferred shafts, grips, and any loft/lie adjustments. We’ll custom‑assemble your set in‑house and invoice you for the difference—no hassle, just perfectly matched clubs.

products.title: Haywood Copper-Torched Wedges – Heads Only
products.body_html:
Turn up the heat on your short game.
We started with our tour-trusted wedge head, laid down a raw copper layer, and hit it with a hand-torch until it bloomed into swirling purples, blues, and sunset golds. No two wedges emerge from the flame with the same pattern, so yours will be as individual as the flop shot you brag about on 17.

Why You’ll Love Gaming (and Staring At) These

  • Hand-Torched Copper Finish – Every head spends time under a hand torch, creating one-of-a-kind color gradients that will mellow into a rich patina over time.
  • Spin on Command – CNC-milled grooves and a laser-etched face texture generate hop-and-stop bite, even from wet rough.
  • Wear That Tells a Story – Copper will scuff, darken, and polish in high-contact spots. It won’t look mint forever—just better.

products.title: Haywood “Blue Steel” Signature Blade Putter – RH
products.body_html:
Cooler than a 12-foot birdie putt. We wrapped our precision-milled Signature Blade in deep-blue Cerakote, ran the hue straight down a matching blue shaft, and finished the look with a blue-and-white SuperStroke grip that says, “Yes, I absolutely drain sliders.” Built for right-handers who like their putters as sharp as their reads, the Blue Steel is equal parts statement piece and scoring weapon.

Ice-Cold Reasons to Bag It

  • Blue Cerakote Head: Ultra-durable ceramic coating shrugs off bag chatter and bunker splash while looking wicked under flat light.
  • Blue Shaft, Same Vibes: Color-matched steel shaft keeps the theme rolling from hosel to butt cap—no clashing chrome here.
  • Signature Blade DNA: 100% CNC-milled 303 stainless, classic plumber’s neck, and a face-balanced profile for slight-arc strokes.
  • Putter Cover Included

Roll True, Look Cooler

From practice green swagger to walk-in finishers, the Blue Steel Signature Blade turns routine lag putts into highlight reels—and does it in full-bleed blue. Add it to the bag before someone else beats you to the punch(line).

products.title: Haywood “24K One-Off” RH Signature Blade Putter
products.body_html:
Gold you can game. History you can hold. We took a right-handed precision-milled Signature Blade—trusted for its classic silhouette and razor-sharp feedback—and bathed every millimeter in 24-karat brilliance. A matching gold shaft carries the sheen from hosel to head, while twin 10 g sole weights keep the swing weight tour-tight beneath all that bullion. Topped with a Winn Pistol grip for glove-like control and delivered in a headcover, this is the only example that will ever exist. Once it leaves our build shop, the mold is metaphorically (and literally) broken.

Why This Putter Is in a League of One

  • 24-Karat Plated Head: Mirror-bright finish over 303 SS core delivers jewelry-grade looks with championship-grade feel.
  • Signature Blade DNA: Thin top line, responsive milled face, and a plumber’s-neck design for slight-arc strokes.
  • Dial-in Sole Weights: Twin 10 g screws let you fine-tune head mass to your tempo even after the gold rush.
  • Winn Pistol Grip: Tacky, cushioned texture muffles excessive hand action and frames the gold like suede on silk.

Claim the Only One Ever Made

This isn’t “limited edition”—it’s singular. Bag it, display it, gift it, bequeath it—but know you’ll be the only golfer on Earth who can call it mine. First to act owns the legend; everyone else gets the lore.

Why It Plays (and Looks) Different

  • Emerald Cerakote finish: Hard-as-nails coating in Irish green that shrugs off sand-blast wear and turns heads on the dance floor.
  • Bright Lights ferrule: Multi-hued accent ring that pops against the green, signaling “custom” from a tee box away.
  • Recoil Proto F4 shaft: Graphite stability with steel-like control; mid-launch profile delivers penetrating spin without ballooning.
  • Haywood 360 grip: All-weather traction, classic taper-free feel—no logo twisting when you open the face for that feathery flop.
  • Tour-inspired sole grind: Versatile mid-bounce sole glides through tight lies and damp turf alike, letting you flight or flop at will.

Quick Specs

Part Spec
Loft / Lie 56°
Finish Green Cerakote (matte)
Ferrule Bright Lights custom multi-color
Shaft UST Recoil Prototype F4 (Stiff, 125 g)
Grip Haywood 360 Standard – black, logo-down

Add a Little Shamrock Swagger to Your Bag

Whether you’re chasing skins or scrambling for par, the Irish Magic wedge turns tricky greenside shots into easy tap-ins—no four-leaf clover required. Snag it before this limited wedge disappears like morning fog over Ballybunion.

products.title: Limited Edition RH CB 4-PM (heads only)
products.body_html:
The Haywood cavity-backs, reimagined in copper We took our CB heads, layered them in copper, and built a single Right-Handed 4–PW set. That’s it. No backups, no restocks, no “Limited-Edition-but-Actually-Mass-Produced” nonsense. Whoever bags these irons owns a literal piece of Haywood history.

Why This Set Hits Different

  • CB DNA: Tour-inspired shaping, thin topline, and buttery 8620 carbon-steel feel that made these a cult favorite.
  • Copper with character: Raw finish that will patina uniquely to your game. Tiny freckles and hue shifts are intentional—proof of authenticity.

Quick Specs

  • Set Makeup: 4 – PW (7 irons)
  • Head Material: 8620 carbon steel w/ raw copper overlay
  • Finish: Untreated copper (ages into a dark patina)
  • Grooves: CNC-milled for max spin and control

products.title: Limited Edition Copper Wedge (Heads Only)
products.body_html:
Our small-batch copper wedges are built for the player who wants a club that turns heads. Each head is hand-finished with a copper coating that will patina over time, adding character after every up-and-down. Because the coating is done one head at a time, you’ll notice tiny marks and tonal shifts—think of them as proof that no two wedges (or golfers) are exactly alike.

Why You’ll Want One in the Bag

  • Soft, buttery feel: Copper’s naturally softer than stainless, giving you a muted “thud” and laser-like feedback around the greens.
  • Goes full vintage: Leave it in the rain or baby it with a towel, or even torch it for an ultra unique look. Either way the finish will age into a rich, dark patina unique to you.
  • Collector’s count: Fewer than few heads exist.

Heads-Up on Blemishes

Copper loves to show its story. Minor surface marks, freckles, and hue variations are intentional and do not affect performance—they’re badges of authenticity.

Specs at a Glance

  • Body: 8620 carbon steel with copper overlay
  • Lofts: 50° | 52° | 54° | 56° | 58° | 60°
  • Bounce/Grind: Tour-inspired mid-sole for versatility off tight lies and fluffy bunkers
  • Finish: Raw copper (will patina)

products.title: Magnetic Golf Towel
products.body_html:
Designed to make your golf game smoother (and cleaner), Haywood Golf’s Magnetic Golf Towels combine effortless convenience with bold style. Never lose your towel mid-round again—simply snap it onto your cart, clubs, or any metal surface thanks to a powerful silicone-covered magnet.

Crafted from premium, ultra-absorbent microfiber, these towels swiftly wipe away dirt, moisture, and grass, keeping your gear pristine swing after swing. With a generous 23 x 16-inch surface, there's plenty of room to handle even the muddiest conditions. Plus, an added carabiner clip ensures easy attachment to your golf bag, providing versatility on and off the course.

Available in a range of playful patterns to match your personality:

  • On the Rocks: Tee off in style with this spirited golf-and-alcohol-inspired design.
  • Fore-est Camo: Blend into the greens (but stand out among friends) with this classic green camo.
  • Eagle Has Landed: Reach for the stars and lower your scores with this astronaut-themed coastal golfing towel.
  • Coastal Camo: Ride the wave of style with a refreshing blue camo look.
  • Haywood Signature: For those who want to rep the brand.

Practical, stylish, and effortlessly accessible—the Haywood Golf Magnetic Towel is a must-have for every golfer’s bag.

products.title: DI.2
products.body_html:
⚠️Important: Options may not appear in the Shop App. Please view this product on our website to select your custom options before purchasing.

Introducing the DI.2 – Our Next-Gen Driving Iron.

Built for explosive distance and unmatched forgiveness, it delivers higher ball speeds and a softer feel with every swing. 

The DI.2 features a 17-4SS body paired with a new S450 face material, optimized with a thinner face for maximum power. To enhance your playing experience, we’ve strategically injected 23g of foam for improved sound, feel and improved distance control.

Available in 18º and 21º lofts.

Key Features:

  • 17-4SS Body | S450 Face: Unlock explosive distance and a piercing ball flight.
  • Foam Injection: Enjoy enhanced sound and feel for a satisfying swing.
  • Thinner Face Design: Achieve increased distance with every strike.

Loft guide

Choose the flight your bag needs.

18° 2-iron

Lower flight. More control.

The stronger option for controlled tee shots, wind, and firm conditions.

21° 3-iron

More launch. Easier access.

The more approachable choice for tee shots and clean fairway lies.

Choose by the carry-distance gap between your longest iron and shortest fairway wood.

2-iron vs 3-iron vs hybrid ↗ Driving iron vs fairway wood ↗ View the shaft guide ↗

Common questions

Know before you build.

Is a driving iron harder to hit than a hybrid?

A driving iron generally rewards a more consistent strike and produces a flatter flight. A hybrid usually launches more easily and offers more help on off-centre contact.

Can the DI.2 replace a hybrid or fairway wood?

It can if it produces the carry distance and shot window your bag needs. Compare average carry, launch, and dispersion rather than loft alone.

products.title: Haywood CB's
products.body_html:
⚠️Important: Options may not appear in the Shop App. Please view this product on our website to select your custom options before purchasing.

The Haywood CB irons were built with the intention for average to above-average golfers to hit the shots they want while providing increased forgiveness, exceptional feel, and performance. First forged using 1020 carbon steel and then 100% milled, allows for the tightest weight and club measurement tolerances in the industry. With precision milling and perimeter weighting, the CB’s are an easier-hitting and more forgiving set of irons. 

Designed with the visual golfer in mind, the Haywood CB’s have reduced offset and topline thickness, which gives every golfer a higher level of confidence every time they line up their shot. A beautifully milled back, coupled with the modern and simplistic design Haywood is known for, makes these CB’s a set you’d feel proud to carry in your bag.

Benefits/Features:

  • Minimal Offset and Reduced Topline Thickness
  • Slightly thicker sole than Haywood MB irons
  • Exceptional Shot Shaping Ability
  • Soft Forged Feel
  • Combo Ability with Haywood MB’s

products.title: Signature Wedges
products.body_html:
⚠️ Important: Options may not appear in the Shop App. Please view this product on our website to select your custom options before purchasing.

Our Signature Series Forged wedges are forged from S20C carbon steel, which will provide the soft feel you want along with the high performance you need.

Performance

We CNC milled the grooves and the face right to the legal limit, according to the rules of golf, which will provide you with maximum control. Whether you're hitting an approach shot or chipping around the green, our signature wedges will give you all the confidence in the world to hit the shot required.

Higher Performing Stock Components

Our wedges come stock with 5 different shaft options. Our Raw (will patina/rust over time) and Brushed Silver finish are offered at no upcharge as well, all combined with our Haywood velvet grips in 3 different sizes.

Upgrade options are available for shafts, grips and finish (Long Lasting Black Nitride). Custom stamping is also available.

*Raw wedges may have tiny blemishes at delivery. This is not under our control as the raw steel can rust/patina at any time during the build/transportation process.
